text_block_list.text:
By now, Эйсин Флэш has a number of
victories
under her belt.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's getting an award for setting a new
record.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: As for what it's for...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш has won an astounding
number of G1
races here at Tokyo
Racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Racecourse Staff

text_block_list.text: Congratulations on your achievement!
text_block_list.name: Racecourse Staff

text_block_list.text: Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Once again, allow me to remind
everyone that
these are G1 races that
she has won! This is a
truly historical
record she has made!
text_block_list.name: Racecourse Staff

text_block_list.text:
It's no stretch calling her the Ace of
Tokyo! Here
is the champion of Tokyo,
Eishin Flash!
text_block_list.name: Racecourse Staff

text_block_list.text:
I would not refer to myself as such, but
thank you
for your kind words.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Now, let's hear from the coolheaded
champion
herself! Could you please tell
us your thoughts on
your incredible
accomplishment?
text_block_list.name: Racecourse Staff

text_block_list.text:
First, I would like to thank everyone for
preparing
this wonderful venue.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Thinking back, it was here at the Tokyo

Racecourse that I saw my first race in
Japan three
years ago.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to see for myself what races in
Japan
were like and get a better sense
of them...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But I was immediately captivated by the
racers'
immense skill. That was when I
swore to myself
that I would race
alongside them one day...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш pauses and glances in my
direction.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And with support from many people, I
was able to
achieve that. No, I did not
simply achieve my
dreams—I exceeded
them.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Allow me to use this platform to express
my
gratitude for everyone who has
helped me
become this strong.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Эйсин Флэш! In honor of your
grand
achievement, we have prepared
something for
you.
text_block_list.name: Racecourse Staff

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Please behold!
text_block_list.name: Racecourse Staff

text_block_list.text:
The staff member pulls back the curtain
to reveal
a memorial plaque dedicated
to Эйсин Флэш.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wow...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
This is your very own monument! The
picture in
the center displays the
moment you crossed the
finish line
during your senior year and won the

autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Racecourse Staff

text_block_list.text:
I'm so overwhelmed... I cannot think of
what to
say, but...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
This is truly an honor. Thank you so
much.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome, and
congratulations!
text_block_list.name: Racecourse Staff

text_block_list.text:
After the event ends, Эйсин Флэш
approaches me.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer, I would like to ask you a favor.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Would you mind taking a picture next to
this
monument? I'd like to show my
parents.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Sure! I can take it on my phone for you.

text_block_list.text: Ah, pardon. Allow me to clarify...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I would like to take a picture together
with you, if
that is fine?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Let's stand either side of the monument
for it.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Hm? Trainer, you're out of the frame...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I should have asked Falcon for
instructions on
how to take selfies
properly...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
...Phew. I finally got a good picture of
the two of
us.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I will be sure to master selfie-taking in

preparation for next time...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: What do you mean by "next time"?

text_block_list.text:
A great many races remain on our
schedule.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I shall leave behind even greater records
in those
and surely have another
monument built for me at
some point.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
As long as we work together, we can
make it all a
reality!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
